nodes.label: Extended Hildebrand Solubility Approach (EHSA)
nodes.rationale: Hildebrand-Scatchard Regular Solution Theory only handles nonpolar drugs in nonpolar solvents, whereas pharmacy mostly deals with polar irregular solutions; EHSA modifies it to cover polar and non-polar solutes.
